label: No placebo
rationale: This is an open-label, uncontrolled study where all participants receive the investigational gene therapy, with only a prophylactic corticosteroid given to reduce reactions. There is no inactive or active-placebo comparator described, and the design explicitly says participants will receive a single injection of the study drug.

evidence.quote: All participants will receive a single injection of the study drug.
18 participants will receive dose 1 administered intra cisterna magna.

title: Study is to Assess the Safety and Tolerability of VTx-002 in Participants With ALS

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
